title: The burning of the south, 1359–1366
note: Three wars crossed southern Iberia in these seven years: Castile and Portugal against Aragon (from 1359), the Marīnid war on Castile (1360–1365) and the War of Independence (1363–1366). The before save is 15 March 1359; the peace save is 5 April 1366, the day of the peace with Castile; the after save is 6 November 1366.
